messages:
Joey: Heads up — trying to schedule canary for rollout R-430 tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 change window. Deploy-bot put the job on a waitlist due to a quota overlap with R-427. Need platform + SRE to either approve an override or suggest a new window. https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/R-430 :eyes:

Maya: pasted deploy-bot output below — shows why it was waitlisted:

```
deploy-bot: waitlist entry
rollout: R-430
requested_window: 2026-03-25T02:00Z - 2026-03-25T04:00Z
conflict: R-427 (reserved capacity, high-priority)
quota_remaining_for_window: 0
auto-dequeue: when conflicting rollout completes or approver override added
```

deploy-bot: Automated note — R-430 added to waitlist due to capacity quota conflict. To request override, comment with @carla and @ben and include justification. :robot_face:

Carla: @Joey can you confirm the canary traffic plan? If we can keep initial split at 2-5% and ramp slowly w/ a short guard TTL I can try a soft priority bump. If it needs 20% immediately we should move windows.

Joey: plan is 5% initial -> 25% in 30m -> 50% in 2h. Guard policy: fail-fast on 1% absolute error delta or 5x baseline latency regression within each bucket. We also rely on the KV cache warmup; higher initial traffic would cause extra cost.

Ivan: quick suggested rollout config to paste into console UI:

```json
{"traffic_policy": {"initial": 0.05, "ramp_to": 0.25, "ramp_duration_minutes": 30, "final": 0.5}, "guards": {"error_rate_delta": 0.01, "latency_multiplier": 5, "bucket_duration_seconds": 300, "grace_ttl_seconds": 600}}
```

Ben: SRE perspective — we prefer not to bump priority for reserved-capacity windows unless it's a blocking customer incident. If R-427 is reserved for a customer SLA, we should move R-430. If R-427 is a normal deploy we can allow a temporary quota bump but need an audit entry and on-call ack.

Joey: R-427 is a dedicated capacity change for a new customer rollout (enterprise). Fine to move R-430, can the team do a +/-2h shift? 00:00-02:00 or 04:00-06:00 both work for infra.

Carla: I can try to push R-430 to 04:00-06:00 — that avoids the reserved block and keeps us in the same day. I'll attempt a schedule update now and request approval from on-call.

Maya: thanks — I'll update the CI job to request the new window. Also adding a small post-rollback eval set to catch regressions early.

Ben: on-call acked in PM channel, fine with 04:00-06:00 as long as the rollout guard is strict. Please include a telemetry hook to fire an immediate rollback if error spikes >1.5% absolute.

Joey: noted. Carla — if you make the change can you also add an explicit audit comment (reason: avoid reserved capacity conflict with R-427)? We need that for postmortem if we ever oncall revert.

Carla: done. Updated window to 2026-03-25T04:00Z - 2026-03-25T06:00Z and added audit note. Requesting deploy-bot to dequeue R-430. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Action taken — R-430 dequeued and scheduled for 2026-03-25T04:00Z - 2026-03-25T06:00Z after approver override. Audit id: audit-20260324-7812.

Joey: awesome, thanks all. Will monitor the canary dashboard and post any anomalies here.

Ivan: small UX follow-up — can we add a lightweight checkbox in the rollout coordinator UI that auto-attaches the standard guard JSON when teams select "canary"? It would reduce manual copy/paste errors. Filing a ticket now.

Joey: +1 for that enhancement. File the ticket and tag devex.

Ben: closing loop — SRE happy with plan as long as telemetry gate is wired. Good job coordinating.

Joey: :tada:
